title: PHX Security Summit — logistics & expense workpad
content:
Quick personal workpad for the Phoenix Security Summit (Mar 15–17, 2026). Mostly travel/admin notes, receipts checklist, vendor contact stash, and a short day-by-day run of what I need to do before/after the trip.

High-level goals:
- Attend two sponsor track talks and the networking dinner on Tue 3/16 (ticket covered by Redwood events).
- Meet with 3 prospective customers (scheduling w/ Rachel).
- Collect receipts and submit expense report by EOD Mon 3/23 to hit payroll cutoff.

Bookings and critical details:
- Flights (booked via Concur): SFO -> PHX, United UA 2431 dep 03/15 06:15 am, return UA 2460 dep 03/18 19:20. Booking ref: CONC-58421.
- Hotel: The Hermosa Phoenix, 1 E Washington St — check-in 03/15 15:00, check-out 03/18 11:00. Reg confirmation HERM-RED-331. Use company rate code REDWOOD_CORP.
- Airport transfer: Lyft estimated $35 each way (use company Lyft ridership profile). Keep ride receipts.
- Ground contact in Phoenix: Sophie Kim (local) — cell: +1-602-555-0198. Will coordinate rides to venue.

Conference logistics notes:
- Badge pickup: Conference center, West Hall, Mon 3/14 early access 4–6pm (exhibitor). I might skip — verify with Sophie.
- Booth duty: I am scheduled for booth shift Tue 3/16 11:30–13:30 (Rachel covering morning). Bring 1 spare laptop, printed one-pager (see drive: confluence link), business cards.
- Networking dinner: Tue 3/16 19:00 — vendor table for sponsors; RSVPs closed. Food is included but reimbursements for guest meals allowed up to $75/person pre-approval with events.

Expense capture checklist (must attach receipts to Concur item):
- Travel: airfare, baggage fees, seat selection fees.
- Ground transit: Lyft receipts, uber, rental car if used (rare). Include boarding pass or credit card transaction.
- Hotel: nightly folio and incidentals. Make sure corporate folio shows room rate. If incidentals posted, capture itemized folio.
- Meals: per-diem policy — save receipts for any meal > $25 or if client meal and > $75. Note attendees and purpose for client meals.
- Promotional items: table swag invoices (order placed with RedFed Promotions, see vendor below).
- Other: printing, shipping to booth (UPS receipts), AV rental invoice.

Reimbursement process notes:
- Submit within 7 days of return to hit monthly payroll reimbursement. Attach scanned receipts to Concur expense.
- Tag expenses with project code: EVT-PHX-2026 and line item: marketing-sponsor. If any special approval required for >$500 hospitality, route to Marcus Lee.

Vendor and supplier contacts (stashed quick dial):
- RedFed Promotions (swag + lanyards) — contact: Javier Morales, javier@redfedpromos.com, +1-415-555-0143. Order ref RED-7731. Need final invoice before 03/10 for payment processing.
- PrintOnDemand AZ (backdrop + 2 posters) — contact: Lila O'Connor, lila@printondemandaz.com, +1-602-555-0234. Pickup at hotel loading dock 03/15 before 10:00.
- AV Rentals Southwest — tech lead: Ben Cho, ben.cho@avr-sw.com, +1-480-555-0300. Confirm HDMI adapters and mic stand. They bill event directly; request corporate invoice to accounts-payable@redwood.ai.

People/meetings to schedule before I go:
- Quick pre-brief w/ Rachel: finalize three prospect meeting times (target Mon 3/16 14:00, Tue 3/16 16:00, Wed 3/17 10:30). Put tentative invites and link to calendar event.
- One-pager review: ask Tom to re-run copy edit on sponsor one-pager. Deadline 03/09.
- Expense a11y: drop a note to Finance for per-diem clarification for PHX (timing falls mid-month) — Marcus Lee accounting.

Packing & on-site kit (short):
- Laptop + charger, dongles (USB-C to HDMI), spare battery pack.
- Business cards (100), sponsor one-pager (20), sticker pack (50).
- Small toolkit: gaffer tape, double-sided tape, travel extension cord, SD card reader, pens, notepad.
- Receipts folder (physical envelope) + phone photos backup of each receipt.

Day-by-day personal TODOs while on trip:
- 03/15 (Mon): Arrive by 09:30, check-in, quick walk to venue to confirm booth placement, meet Sophie for lunch to sync schedule.
- 03/16 (Tue): Booth shift 11:30–13:30; prospect meet 14:00; keynote+networking dinner 19:00. Take notes for follow-ups. Capture all receipts.
- 03/17 (Wed): Final prospect at 10:30, pack booth materials early afternoon, check email for follow-up request. Return flight 19:20.

Loose questions / TODO before submit:
- Confirm whether Redwood will reimburse parking at SFO airport — policy ambiguous. Drop quick note to travel@redwood.ai.
- Does corporate card cover fringe AV charges onsite or must we pre-pay and claim? Check with events ops.
- Final swag invoice: make sure vendor sent itemized invoice (no tax errors).

Misc scratch ideas (brain dump):
- Small experiment: use QR on one-pager that points to short demo video so booth staff can triage interest quickly — create short 45s clip, host on internal S3 link.
- Capture short post-conference survey for prospects (one-click response), add to follow-up email template.

End-of-trip immediate checklist (day 0–2 after return):
- Upload all receipts to Concur and submit expense report with EVT-PHX-2026 tag.
- Slack message #events: quick trip highlights and 3 action items.
- Send follow-up emails to prospects within 48 hours with links to demo and calendar times.

Notes-to-self:
- If any vendor invoice >$1k call AP to flag potential payment window.
- Keep physical copy of hotel folio until expense is fully reimbursed.
- Drop an internal note in confluence with annotated photos of booth layout and sample lead cards.

Reference links and attachments I need to add:
- One-pager draft (drive: docs/rdw-phx-onepager-v3)
- Swag invoice PDF (RedFed)
- Hotel folio template example from last event (link to confluence page above)

-- end of workpad --

(Throwaway notes OK here; will move to shared events doc post-review.)
